core_obligations: Part (1): argue functoriality of Tr_{f, w, F} in F either from the construction in the proof of the existence lemma or from the stalk characterization forcing it on all stalks (proof lines 2215-2218).

Part (2): set up the cartesian square, promote w' = w composed with g' to a weighting of f' via the weighting base change lemma, write the commutative square relating g^{-1}Tr_{f, w, F} and Tr_{f', w', g^{-1}F}, identify its left vertical arrow using the base change isomorphism for lower shriek, and conclude commutativity from the stalk descriptions (proof lines 2219-2250).

Part (3): given (1) and (2), obtain Tr_{f, w, K} on the derived category by applying f^{-1} and f_! to representing complexes, inheriting functoriality and base change compatibility (proof lines 2252-2257).
proof_roadmap: Functoriality in F from the stalk characterization (proof lines 2215-2218).
Base change diagram and its commutativity for a cartesian square (proof lines 2219-2250).
Derived category version by termwise transport (proof lines 2252-2257).
